title: Read the cooking time
why: Step 'Set the time' needs you to turn the time on the package into numbers to press.

steps.text: Find the word "Microwave" on the package
Find the time next to it, like "2 min 30 sec" or "2:30"
Minutes come first, then seconds. 2 min 30 sec is 2:30

tips: Two times, like "2 to 3 min"? Use the smaller one first. You can add more time later
It says to stir halfway? Remember that for later
